waypoints.name: Abric Pedro más

waypoints.name: Olula

waypoints.name: Barranco del Cabezo del moro

sections.advice: Barranco del Cabezo del moro → Abric Pedro más is 16 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Abric Pedro más → Olula is 28 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Olula → back through Abric Pedro más is 28 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
back through Abric Pedro más → Barranco del Cabezo del moro is 16 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-barranco-del-cabezo-del-moro-olul.story: 94 km from Almansa to Almansa, about 1 h 37 of riding. It goes by way of Abric Pedro más, Olula and back through Abric Pedro más. The highest point is about 850 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
